purpose: Localise the block-0, position-0 divergence to a specific op and characterise its magnitude error, using the certified executor's stored per-tensor captures as ground truth.
method: Anchored on the certified modelgenie executor's --differential captures (diff_pos1), validated against llama.cpp 20/20 on overlapping positions. Captured the runtime graph's block-0 tensors with an env-gated dump (RR_DUMP_TENSORS / RR_DUMP_LAYER / RR_DUMP_DIR) and compared against the anchor. The dumped arena hooks were reverted from the working tree after use so no debug code remains.

verified.detail: cos(my attn_norm, certified attn_norm) = 1.00000000, L2 27.8429 vs 27.8430. The runtime graph's norm path is correct. Rules out the norm as the defect.

first_divergent_op.op: MlaDecompress (block 0, position 1 of a 2-token anchor run)
first_divergent_op.detail: k(3072)||v(2048) = 5120 which exactly equals ground truth MlaDecompress_Output width, so the k/v split is correct. The magnitudes are wrong: native k body ~0.04 vs ground truth ~0.31; native rope-region ~-1.83 vs ground truth ~0.13.
first_divergent_op.interpretation: The MLA decompress produces an uncorrelated result with the wrong magnitude. Since the norm that feeds it is bit-exact, the fault is inside the MLA projection path itself, not upstream.

ordered_divergence_chain: 1. MlaDecompress (k||v) - cos -0.0021 vs ground truth. FIRST DIVERGENCE.
2. q projection - cos 0.714 vs ground truth (partially correlated; the norm is right so the projection's row indexing is suspect).
3. attention output - wrong downstream of the two above.

ground_truth_reference_values.k_rope: n=64 L2=23.5778 (rotation preserves L2, as expected)
ground_truth_reference_values.note: Ground truth k_rope differs from k_rope_raw by max 4.06, confirming RoPE is applied and is non-identity at position 1.

what_is_not_claimed: No root cause inside OpMlaDecompress (kv_a_mqa row indexing, kv_b row indexing, latent slice, or rope tail offset are all still candidates).

next.method: Dump latentFull (the kv_a_mqa output) from the runtime graph and compare it to the ground truth latent 512 and the ground truth rope 64. That isolates whether the fault is in the kv_a_mqa projection, the latent RMSNorm, or the kv_b projection - the three remaining candidates inside this op.
